coverageContext: Complete seven-term IgE research score using the original adult-derived GWAS beta coefficients. Evaluation is from the Dutch TRAILS adolescent cohort; the primary abstract describes 1354 participants overall and a third-wave mean age of16.22years, but trait-specific evaluation sample sizes must be read from the frozen Catalog record. This does not establish adult clinical prediction. GA reports only the genetic weighted sum, not a measured serum IgE concentration, allergen-specific sensitization, allergy/asthma diagnosis, anaphylaxis risk or treatment advice. Clinical usefulness and individual applicability are not established. The full deposited paper was not retrievable for detailed table verification in this review; no unverified paper-specific performance or transformation is applied.
